decision: sequence the architecture program as one verified and merged bead at a time
why: each change must remain small enough to diagnose and safe enough to land independently

decision: installed the uv version required by the repository before running checks
why: the sandbox uv 0.9.7 could not parse metadata written for uv 0.10 or newer

decision: added a PostgreSQL contract that fails after real claim completion inside the terminal transaction
why: the test must prove all terminal writes share one connection and one rollback boundary
result: unit lint and type gates passed; PostgreSQL proof pending CI

decision: merged the terminal rollback contract after the full CI gate passed
why: package moves now have a real PostgreSQL transaction baseline

decision: pinned framework imports, HTTP routes and middleware, and the MCP wire manifest
why: later module moves need executable checks that fail on contract drift
result: 485 unit tests passed; full CI pending

decision: split review persistence into queue and feedback owners with neutral connection aliases in database.py
why: queue lifecycle and append-only feedback have distinct ownership but feedback consequences must remain one transaction
result: legacy review postgres and models modules deleted; 485 unit tests passed; PostgreSQL proof pending CI

decision: moved curation and immutable manifest evidence into one deep benchmark owner
why: manifest identity and projection enqueue share the same authoritative transaction while execution consumes the frozen evidence
result: 486 unit tests passed; moved SQL and payloads matched origin/main; PostgreSQL proof pending CI

decision: split scoring, execution, comparison, and promotion into explicit benchmark owners
why: pure evidence derivation stays separate from persisted execution and decision transactions while the provider adapter and activation CAS retain their boundaries
result: 486 unit tests passed; schemas, SQL, function bodies, payloads, and protected bytes matched ab78ebb; PostgreSQL proof pending CI

decision: split the durable outbox, Langfuse adapter, rebuild, and live smoke operations into focused projection owners
why: external telemetry stays write-only while authoritative benchmark transactions retain their original enqueue positions
result: 491 unit tests passed; SQL, digests, schemas, payload behavior, and protected bytes matched 875a947; PostgreSQL proof pending CI

decision: extracted shared FastHTML construction, security helpers, infrastructure routes, static assets, and document rendering into the web package
why: HTTP mechanics now have adapter owners while review onboarding policy and feature routes remain with their capabilities
result: 493 unit tests passed; route names and order, middleware, CSS, HTML, static URLs, and asset bytes matched e1a4503; PostgreSQL proof pending CI

decision: extracted review queue, item, and feedback HTTP behavior into one immutable ReviewWorkbench
why: one capability owner now contains the review transport and rendering while app.py retains composition and owner policy
result: 498 unit tests passed; routes, factory signature, normalized HTML, redirects, states, and submissions matched b4fd27a; PostgreSQL proof pending CI

decision: extracted configuration HTTP routes, form transport, and rendering into one configuration capability adapter
why: configuration service state and PostgreSQL wiring remain framework-free while app.py composes the capability at the original route position
result: 500 unit tests passed; factory signature, route names and order, normalized HTML, statuses, redirects, and service commands matched 8124a2e; PostgreSQL proof pending CI

decision: rebased the configuration adapter extraction onto current main before review
why: current trunk added behavior and contract coverage that the extraction must preserve
evidence: origin/main a6334b1; baseline a64c2b6; job_finder test suite
result: 541 unit tests passed; current factory, routes, normalized HTML, statuses, redirects, service calls, and commands matched a64c2b6

decision: split acquisition policy and qualification definition lifecycles while retaining one owner-facing Search setup workflow
why: the current aggregate couples authoring while runtime, promotion, and execution already select acquisition and release targets independently
result: product direction approved; aggregate names, transitions, identity, MCP cutover, provenance, and migration policy recorded in the tracker and CONTEXT.md

decision: keep one atomic qualification target composed from independently evidenced component releases
why: separate active phase pointers would permit combinations no benchmark exercised, while the legacy relevance gate can currently approve uncovered behavior
result: three independent reviewers agreed on atomic activation, fixed experiment inputs, verified executor identity, component evidence, and explicit legacy variants
